title: Fix every review finding on its branch before any fix PR opens
context: Independent reviews of the six mitosis branches found: drafts written back after close through a lifecycle flush (HIGH) and a close-before-load race deleting an unseen draft (LOW); integration sandbox not redirecting drafts (LOW); preview cutting a leading photo, diverging from old plain-prose output, merging blocks around a dropped photo, and floating a kept photo that the read view stacks (MEDIUM); slim-mode pick error toast hidden under the keyboard with a success check (MEDIUM); stale decode error inherited by a new photo (LOW); benchmark samples mixing cold and cached images while the doc claimed decode was excluded (MEDIUM); GC guard counting files not calls and three golden dependencies missing from the workflow (MEDIUM). The corrupt-photo Worker also exited without a return line, so mitosis marked that lane failed.
options: open the PRs as built and file the findings as follow-ups
fix each finding on its own branch, test-first, amend the fix-wave spec where a ruling changed, and re-review before opening PRs
outcome: Fix on-branch before PRs. Drafts: controller seals on discard and after save (seal delegates to discard), a close waits up to 2 s for restore before judging clean, sandbox overrides draftRootProvider. Preview: leading photo kept whole, photo after the kept photo ends the preview, dropped photo leaves a line break, fit judged by the photo line, prose identical to the old algorithm (5000-note differential check). Composer: showTransientToast gains a glyph parameter and rises above the keyboard. Corrupt photo: NotePhotoFigure keyed by reference; the failed lane was finished by hand with the same revert probe mitosis runs (both properties load-bearing). Bench: images warmed into ImageCache before timing and asserted painted on the first sample. Guards: calls counted per file; three more workflow paths.
